Looking at the data:
- Zone F3_Z01 temperature rises from ~22.5°C (Jan 2018) to ~25.1°C (Jul–Dec 2018) to ~26.4°C (Jan 2019), while other zones' average stays in the 24–25°C range throughout.
- VAV_F3_Z01 damper position setpoint barely changes (0.18%→0.44%→0.23%), so the controller is not opening more to combat new load.
- Cooling/heating setpoints are essentially constant (~25.2/18.5) until Jan 2019 when heating sp drops.
- No zone-level power/CO2/occupancy values are exposed, and no second independent temperature sensor for this zone.

We have neither a second sensor to cross-check a calibration drift (sensor-fault hypothesis) nor a load/flow signal to confirm additional heat generation (load-change hypothesis). The data therefore cannot tell the two causes apart.

input.needed_streams: Zone_F3_Z01 independent second air-temperature sensor (cross-check); Zone_F3_Z01 electric power / heat load; VAV_F3_Z01 supply air flow (or damper actual position); Zone_F3_Z01 CO2 or occupancy; VAV cooling valve/fan duty; or supply air temperature at the VAV discharge.
